column1: # Single-letter Sucheng fallback (Windows lists one-letter codes only after Space,
# and for most letters that list is phrases, so the capture has no row for them).
# Used only for one-letter codes missing from ms_quick_order.tsv; never for 2-letter
# codes. gen_quick_dict.py exits if a row here disagrees with the measured capture.
# Not Microsoft's lexicon. One code per line: code<TAB>characters. See docs/WIN_QUICK_RANK.md.
